title_left_one: {{count}} step left to your first campaign
title_left_other: {{count}} steps left to your first campaign
title_ready: All set. Launch your first campaign
subtitle: Hontrio builds the campaign from your store's products and sales. You connect the accounts and confirm; Hontrio does the rest.
still_missing: Still missing. If you just made the change, give it a few minutes.
store_done: {{store}} is connected. Hontrio reads its catalog and orders to learn what you sell and what earns you a profit.
store_todo: The connection to your store stopped working. Reconnect it so Hontrio can see your products and orders again.
google_desc: The campaign is created in your own Google Ads account and you pay Google directly. Hontrio runs it from there, with your approval.
google_no_account: No Google Ads account? Create one for free
google_done: Your ads run from the {{account}} account.
tracking_desc: Google needs to see your products (in Merchant Center) and to know when someone buys after an ad. Measured sales teach it who to show your ads to.
costs_desc: From price and cost, Hontrio learns how much you make on each sale and how much it can spend on ads without losing money.
costs_coverage_sales: Cost filled in for {{pct}}% of sales
costs_coverage_catalog: Cost filled in for {{pct}}% of products
costs_estimate_title: Don't have your costs at hand? Estimate them now
costs_estimate_value: Cost is about {{pct}}% of the selling price
costs_estimate_slider: Cost as a percentage of price
costs_apply_one: Fill in {{count}} product without a cost
costs_apply_other: Fill in {{count}} products without a cost
costs_apply_none: Every product already has a cost
costs_estimate_hint: These are estimates: correct them anytime, one by one, in Products.
costs_applied_one: Filled in the cost for {{count}} product.
costs_applied_other: Filled in the cost for {{count}} products.
costs_failed: Couldn't fill in the costs. Try again.
costs_done: Average margin of the products in the campaign: {{pct}}%. Break-even ROAS: {{roas}}.
launch_desc: Choose what you're after and how much to spend per day. Hontrio sets the rest: the target, the products and the loss limits.
budget_after_costs: Hontrio suggests a budget once it knows your product margins (the costs step). You can also enter one now.
forecast_note: If the campaign reaches its target ROAS. Google learns for the first two or three weeks, so the numbers move around.
audit_desc: Before launching, Hontrio reads your Google Ads account: running campaigns, conversions and the Merchant Center link. The check changes nothing.
audit_ok: The account is ready to launch.
launch_note: The campaign starts within a few hours, once Google reviews it. You can pause it anytime.
launch_wait_choices: First choose what to do with your existing campaigns
launching_wait: Usually takes under a minute. Keep this page open.
launched_desc: Google reviews it and starts it within a few hours. From now on, this is where you see what it brings in.
